name: Revive Cost
description: Every grade's revive costs {{price:comma}} KC, including the default revive. The sign held up in-game is a texture, so it still shows the old price - you pay {{price:comma}} KC either way.
author: KSFA

settings.label: Price
settings.help: Stock prices run from 1,000 to 50,000 KC depending on grade; this sets them all the same. Capped at 200,000 - the highest value this same price field is ever set to anywhere in the stock game.
